owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — bounded contract step for #2745: the root api package deletes the API aggregate and its New constructor. Every route resource is built and mounted by a mount function in api/base.go and outlives no mount; the Serve root keeps a package-private serveGraph with only the router, the pool, the tenant runtime, the observability handles and the retained composition the embedded Worker still reads (#2749).
affected_tables: None: code-only contract, no database tables or DDL affected.
atomic_cutover: One code-only change in package api: type API and func New are deleted, and the api entry leaves legacy_composition in policy.json. newServeGraph composes the root in New's place; mountRoutes and its route-group functions build each resource and mount its routers at once, the tenant routes on the /api sub-router and the public and portal routers at the root. The issue names no exact key; the five listed keys are #2750 keys that fall incidentally because the root named those workforce route packages only as field types of the aggregate, and the exact-equality ratchet requires removing resolved entries in the same change. The routes still mount through modules/workforce. The Worker reads the staff and student document sweeps from the graph instead of the aggregate's resource fields. No capability behavior, fallback provider or policy rule is added, and the route builders read the composed module set instead of naming the factories, so the typed references to services.Factory stay at the eight declarations of the base and those to repositories.Factory drop from five to three.
